legal.financialText: We maintain complete financial transparency. All donations are tracked, reported, and used exclusively for legal defense, advocacy, and systemic change efforts.
legal.allFundsUsed: 100% of donations go directly to the cause
legal.privacyText: Your privacy is paramount. We protect donor information and respect your preferences regarding recognition.
legal.noDataSharing: No data sharing with third parties

legal.advocacyDesc: Media campaigns, social media, and public awareness about systemic failures.
